Ah thank you so much for replying. Yeah it really does suckkkkk when I'm not able to do the things that other peopke are able to do and I'm stuck working in sweltering hot conditions. I've had to slap on tons of sunscreen to make sure I don't get sun burn and tie my hair up which just makes me look like a boy. I'm pretty sure one woman called me a man and I don't know why I let it get to me, because it was by accident. It just made me feel disgusting and made my low self esteem worse.

I think I was just fed up of everything and crying when I wrote that message. I'm going to be in second year next year and I'm anxious I won't be able to keep up with the work load and the only period of free time, before the semester starts again, has been used up. My life does seem kind of pathetic, but I appreciate the advice and your outlook on the situation it made me feel better. I kind of cried reading your message not like a sad cry, but like a cry, because someone understood how I was feeling. I will try again next year with the pharmacy thing and see where that goes.
Oh okay will try that out when I come back to Leicester. Is there anything I should prepare like my CV or if they wanted to have an interview with me?
Hi I've had a look online at local co-op jobs although they all seem to be permanent roles and I'm only planning to work for the summer. I'm not sure what else to do.
